q1_issues.issue: "her own" is silently dropped -- no Possession links the off-nights to Pell, so the parse widens the claim to off-nights in general.
The plural "off-nights" (several occasions) collapses into a single Past visit event with no recurrence atom and no group witness for the possessed plural.
"every night" is encoded as a period (Every e 1 night), but "night" is a day-part like "morning", which the slot rule maps to (Time e night) + (Every e 1 day); same at 36, 44, 51.

q2_gaps: inceptive verb with an event-denoting NOUN object ("began a solo stretch of thirty nights") -- Inception covers only "to V" / "V-ing" complements, so nothing says whether the noun-eventuality takes Ongoing, its own tense, or a role linking the subject to it

past-tense habitual: a finite past clause carrying "every night" -- Frequency & habitual schedules says the event stays unmarked, Status predicates tenses finite clauses, and no rule says which wins for a habitual bounded inside a past interval (the parse emits both Past and Every)

a possessed plural common-noun NP as a temporal adjunct ("on her own off-nights") -- Time takes structured terms, deictics or bare day-part constants, with no slot for a witness/group that carries a possessor
notes: Roles, the negation bundle, During, compound decomposition (mire_essence, off_night) and cross-sentence coreference (the stretch, the lantern) are all handled correctly. The defects are confined to the "her own off-nights" adjunct and the frequency encoding.
